title: Landing readiness check
description: Before anything lands or waits, the merge asks every landing question at once: review stage, close-out evidence flags, lane, checkout, stale lane, work claim, uncommitted lane files, blocking QA proof and the post-deploy QA answer. It refuses with every failing gate and its recovery in one message; `--check` prints the same report and changes nothing. An item one declared edge before its review stage is not a blocker: the merge moves it into review, running that stage's gates, with `--verification` as the reason. Source-observed; not yet verified against a running Yoke.
